datasets: MPNet 999812 base / 10000 queries, D768, ASH d384, 2 bits, 101 code bytes
OpenAI3072 999000 base / 1000 queries, D3072, ASH d1536, 4 bits, 773 code bytes
backend: native provider in both arms; before uses Panama dense projection/symmetric helpers, after uses Highway for those operations
query_scope: Same saved model and graph before/after; standard three random-query warmup passes, three measured samples over all supplied dataset queries; normal query preparation, graph traversal, fused neighborhood scoring and NVQ reranking included.
same_graph_cache_policy: Existing unchanged saved graph/model caches, linked into isolated case directories. Original cold graph pages are loaded naturally by the standard harness; no manual cache conditioning.
construction_scope: Four fresh after-implementation ASH builds, separate empty model/graph caches, production ITQ training, encoding, deferred parallel writes and NVQ reranking; existing BenchYAML phase timers.
total_process_scope: Fresh build JVM wall time includes startup/loading, training/encoding, graph/write, one standard 1x recall pass, teardown. It is not build-only.
caveats: Focused implementation validation, not a repeat of the full four-dataset PQ/ASH comparison.
One saved graph per comparison and one fresh construction per case; no graph-build variance estimate.
Java still combines symmetric scales/offsets/landmark terms; encoding row projections and standalone asymmetric packed helpers are outside this port.
Pre-final implementation runs archived in superseded-development after the range-counter/critical-work review; unchanged completed baseline query runs retained.
